test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Mohan got a 20% discount on the marked price when he bought a bag. He sold it for 40% more than what he paid for it. The profit percentage on the marked price is:
solution:
Given:

Mohan got a 20% discount on the marked price.

He sold it for 40% more.

Formula used:

Profit = SP – CP

Profit % = (Profit/CP) × 100

Calculation:

Let the MP of the articles be Rs. 100

the C.P after a discount of 20%

= 80

he sold it for 40% more.

= (100 + 40)% of 80

= 140% of 80

= 1.4 × 80

= 112

profit = 112 - 100 = 12

the profit percentage on the marked price

= Profit/MP × 100

= (12)/(100)× 100

= 12 %

**∴ The profit percentage is 12%.**
